Author: jFray
Name: EchoMix
Description: An interactive DJ deck with live mixing tools, custom playlists, and a synced listener mode with an audio visualizer.
Punchline: Spin tracks and let the party sync in.
Changelog: Fixed avatar photos not matching their own frame's corners - Corners and Gradient are genuinely square-cornered styles, so the photo now stays square-cornered for those two instead of the rounded corners every other frame style gets. Also nudged the avatar frame preview in the DJ List edit form right a bit, since the Double and Glow styles' outer rings were running into the form's left edge.
